<androidx.appcompat.widget.Toolbar android:id="@+id/toolbar" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="?attr/actionBarSize" android:background="?attr/colorPrimary" android:theme="@style/ThemeOverlay.AppCompat.Dark.ActionBar" app:popupTheme="@style/ThemeOverlay.AppCompat.Light"/>
<com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayout android:id="@+id/tabLayout" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="?attr/colorPrimary" app:tabMode="scrollable" app:tabTextColor="#CCFFFFFF" app:tabSelectedTextColor="#FFFFFF" app:tabIndicatorColor="#FFFFFF" app:tabIndicatorHeight="3dp" />
<FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_weight="1">
<androidx.viewpager2.widget.ViewPager2 android:id="@+id/viewPager" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" />

</LinearLayout>
